answer: Audits are written down in delta, queued in atlas, and inlet publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 10 identities per epoch. A farm of 231 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1044 identities would post 3270 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
